## Overview

In Lab 3, you practiced individual pandas operations such as filtering,
sorting, calculating summaries, and grouping data. In this lab, you will
combine those operations to investigate patterns in General Conference talks.

You will practice:

- filtering with multiple conditions;
- creating grouped summaries with `.agg()`;
- comparing observations with their groups using `.transform()`;
- creating variables from text;
- comparing raw counts with rates; and
- creating basic plots directly from pandas.

The plots in this lab are exploratory. You will learn how to create more
polished visualizations later in the course.

## Setup

The following code imports pandas and loads the data. Run it before beginning
the lab.

## pandas reminders

These general forms may help:

```python
df.groupby("group").agg(new_name=("column", "mean"))
df.groupby("group")["column"].transform("mean")
df["text"].fillna("").str.lower().str.count("phrase")
```
